SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT dm.member_id) as members_contacted,
  COALESCE(SUM(fsl.net_amount), 0) as total_net_sales
FROM fact_campaign_exposure fce
JOIN dim_member dm ON fce.member_key = dm.member_key
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fsl 
  ON fce.member_key = fsl.member_key
  AND fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'
WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT dm.member_id) as members_contacted,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fsl.sales_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN dm.member_id END) as members_with_sales,
  COUNT(fsl.sales_line_id) as sales_lines_in_period,
  COALESCE(SUM(fsl.net_amount), 0) as total_net_sales
FROM fact_campaign_exposure fce
JOIN dim_member dm ON fce.member_key = dm.member_key
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fsl 
  ON fce.member_key = fsl.member_key
  AND fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'
WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19
GROUP BY fce.campaign_id

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT dm.member_id) as members_contacted,
  COALESCE(SUM(fsl.net_amount), 0) as total_net_sales
FROM fact_campaign_exposure fce
JOIN dim_member dm ON fce.member_key = dm.member_key
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fsl 
  ON fce.member_key = fsl.member_key
  AND fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'
LEFT JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
LEFT JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19
  AND (fsl.sales_line_id IS NULL 
       OR (ds.store_id <> 999 AND dp.category <> 'ZZ Test'))

WITH campaign_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dm.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure fce
  JOIN dim_member dm ON fce.member_key = dm.member_key
  WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19
),
sales_in_period AS (
  SELECT 
    cm.member_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN fsl.channel_code = 'WB' AND fwo.dispatch_ts_utc IS NOT NULL 
      THEN CAST(fwo.dispatch_ts_utc AS DATE)
      ELSE fsl.sale_date 
    END as effective_date,
    fsl.net_amount
  FROM campaign_members cm
  JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON cm.member_id = (
    SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE member_key = fsl.member_key
  )
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order fwo ON fsl.receipt_id = fwo.web_order_id AND fsl.channel_code = 'WB'
  LEFT JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  LEFT JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE ds.store_id <> 999 
    AND dp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as members_contacted,
  COALESCE(SUM(net_amount), 0) as total_net_sales
FROM sales_in_period
WHERE effective_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'

SELECT 
  fsl.channel_code,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(fsl.net_amount), 0) as channel_sales
FROM fact_campaign_exposure fce
JOIN dim_member dm ON fce.member_key = dm.member_key
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fsl 
  ON dm.member_key = fsl.member_key
  AND fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'
LEFT JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
LEFT JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19
  AND (fsl.sales_line_id IS NULL OR (ds.store_id <> 999 AND dp.category <> 'ZZ Test'))
GROUP BY fsl.channel_code

SELECT 
  fsl.channel_code,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(fsl.net_amount), 0) as channel_sales
FROM fact_campaign_exposure fce
JOIN dim_member dm ON fce.member_key = dm.member_key
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fsl 
  ON dm.member_key = fsl.member_key
  AND fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'
LEFT JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
LEFT JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE fce.campaign_id = 19
  AND (fsl.sales_line_id IS NULL OR (ds.store_id <> 999 AND dp.category <> 'ZZ Test'))
  AND fsl.sales_line_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY fsl.channel_code

SELECT 
  channel_code,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'
GROUP BY channel_code
